abstract: In the design of global logistics problems, the solution spaces are typically extremely large. To demonstrate how these challenges can be addressed in Answer Set Programming (ASP), this work investigates a representative industrial use case of a global logistics problem in the aerospace problem domain. An exploration of specific areas of the search space is done by using heuristic-driven solving for the formulation of domain heuristics that guide the solver to potentially desirable configurations. A quantitative evaluation on the Key Performance Indicators and a qualitative evaluation on the variability of the models by means of a similarity analysis shows promising results.
